item.beyondsolo.random_box.desc: A box the System hands out. What is inside is anyone's guess.
item.beyondsolo.blessed_random_box.desc: A box touched by fortune: open it and choose one of three things.
item.beyondsolo.cursed_random_box.desc: It holds more than any other box, and a curse for whoever opens it.
box.beyondsolo.locked: Only a hunter bound to the System can open this.
box.beyondsolo.category.gold.hint: Paid into your purse at once.
box.beyondsolo.category.remedies.hint: Draughts and cures for the road.
box.beyondsolo.category.weapon.hint: A weapon rolled for your class.
box.beyondsolo.category.armor.hint: A piece of armor for your class.
box.beyondsolo.category.cores.hint: Monster cores and mana stones, for crafting.
box.beyondsolo.category.tome.hint: Read it to learn a new skill.
box.beyondsolo.category.rune.hint: A sealed rune stone: absorb it to learn its art.
box.beyondsolo.category.key.hint: Opens a gate of its rank, three steps ahead of you.
box.beyondsolo.category.stats.hint: Points to put into any stat.
box.beyondsolo.curse.wardens.desc: %s wardens climb out of the box. Put them all down before the time runs out, or what it held crumbles to dust.
box.beyondsolo.curse.frailty.desc: A hex takes a share of your health for %s minutes. A purifying draught lifts it.
box.beyondsolo.curse.backlash.desc: The box's mana floods into you: %s points of mana poisoning, wherever you stand.
box.beyondsolo.pick.title: Blessed Random Box
box.beyondsolo.pick.sub: Choose one. The other two go back into the light.
quest.beyondsolo.box.wardens.desc: The cursed box's guardians have climbed out. Put all %s of them down and what the box held is yours. Run or fall, and it crumbles.
notify.beyondsolo.box.crumbled.title: The Box Crumbles
notify.beyondsolo.box.crumbled: The wardens held on. What the cursed box kept has crumbled to dust.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.box.give: Gives random boxes: plain, blessed or cursed, of a rank (the player's own if left out).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.box.curse: Opens a cursed box of a rank on the player at once, with this curse.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.mana.set: Sets the player's mana poisoning, or adds to it (0 to 100; a full 100 bursts).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.mana.crysta: A purifying crystal two blocks ahead of you.
The purifying crystals grown in the gate the player is in; click one to teleport beside it.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.mana.info: The player's mana poisoning, how fast it builds where they stand and the nearest crystal.
command.beyondsolo.solo.mana.info: %s · here it builds %s a second · intelligence holds off %s%% · nearest crystal: %s
command.beyondsolo.solo.mana.crystals.no: No purifying crystals in this %s-Rank gate (they grow in A and S gates).
